# Verb + 到 / Verb + 唔到 · *Verb + dou2 / Verb + m4 dou2*

**Meaning:** manage to; can't manage to · **Level:** B1 · **Topic:** Verb endings and complements

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fdou2-result).

到 (dou2, rising tone) after a verb says the action succeeded: 搵到 (found), 買到 (managed to buy). Put 唔 in between for 'couldn't': 買唔到. This is a different word from 到 (dou3) 'to arrive'.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我搵到我條鎖匙喇。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 wan2 dou2 ngo5 tiu4 so2 si4 laa3. |
| Yale | ngóh wán dóu ngóh tìuh só sìh la. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄨㄜㄣ² ㄉㄛㄨ² ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄊㄧㄨ⁴ ㄙㄛ² ㄙㄧ⁴ ㄌㄚ³. |
| English | I've found my key. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你聽唔聽到呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 teng1 m4 teng1 dou2 aa3? |
| Yale | néih tēng m̀h tēng dóu a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄊㄝㄥ¹ ㆬ⁴ ㄊㄝㄥ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ² ㄚ³? |
| English | Can you hear me? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **佢買唔到飛。** |
| Jyutping | keoi5 maai5 m4 dou2 fei1. |
| Yale | kéuih máaih m̀h dóu fēi. |
| Bopomofo | ㄎㆤㄧ⁵ ㄇㄚㄧ⁵ ㆬ⁴ ㄉㄛㄨ² ㄈㄝㄧ¹. |
| English | He couldn't get a ticket. |
